purpose: Teach: 滞納/突発/陽性/観衆/空爆/同伴/中流/卓越

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、支払い滞納のお取引先には注意しろ
lines.en: Be careful with trading partners who are behind on payments.
lines.style: Clipped, direct authority. No preamble. Each phrase lands like an instruction. Measured pace, steady eye contact. The voice of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。突発的なトラブルに備えた体制を整えます
lines.en: Understood. We'll put together a contingency system for unexpected issues.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Not obsequious. Clear enunciation on each commitment. Calm, capable undertone — reassuring without being presumptuous.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場で陽性的な反応を得る新製品を出せ
lines.en: Get a new product to market that gets positive traction.
lines.style: Sharp, expectant. Slight emphasis on 「positive」 — this matters. No softening. The tone of someone setting a bar and expecting it to be cleared.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。発表会の観衆を増やす広報を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen our PR to drive attendance at the launch event.
lines.style: Focused, efficient. Slightly faster pace — demonstrating readiness. Concrete steps, no hedging. The voice of someone who hears the standard and commits immediately.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、空爆のような価格攻勢には焦らず対応しろ
lines.en: Don't panic when competitors hit us with aggressive pricing. Stay steady.
lines.style: Measured, almost philosophical. Slight weight on 「Don't panic」 — not harsh, but firm counsel. Pause before the final instruction. The voice of experience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様への同伴サービスも検討します
lines.en: Understood. We're also exploring companion services to strengthen customer loyalty.
lines.style: Thoughtful, proactive. Shows he's already one step ahead. Calm assurance — not overstepping but not passive either. Slightly higher confidence than previous responses.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、中流層のニーズに応える製品を出せ
lines.en: Create products that meet the needs of the middle market.
lines.style: Deliberate, focused. Weight on 「middle market」 — this segment matters. Steady tempo, no urgency but unmistakable clarity. The voice of strategic intent.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。卓越した品質を追求し続けます
lines.en: Understood. We'll continue pursuing excellence in every aspect of our quality.
lines.style: Firm closing statement. Slight breath before 「continue」 — it's a commitment, not just compliance. Formal but warm. The voice of someone ending a directive with full buy-in.
